newsitem.title: USA: Dade Cty, Fla., manager says port memo due Monday.
newsitem.headline: Dade Cty, Fla., manager says port memo due Monday.

text.p: Florida's Dade County Manager was scheduled to release a memo late Monday on the resignation of Port of Miami Director Carmen Lunetta, county spokeswoman Cynthia Jones said.
But beyond the memo, Vidal will have no public comment until after a Wednesday morning meeting with county commissioners, Jones said.
Lunetta, 67, faxed his resignation to Vidal late Friday night, saying it would take effect July 31. He had been seaport director for 38 years.

His resignation came after the Miami Herald obtained boxes of records showing port money had been spent on Super Bowl tickets, luxury car rentals and campaign contributions, including contributions to current county commissioners.
Last week, a report released under pressure from commissioners revealed that the port had a $22 million deficit and that county general funds had been used to offset port losses for several years.
